title: Charming Music Row Condo
description:
Our charming condo, The Emmy Lou, is located minutes from downtown and its a close to walk to The Gulch, Music Row, 12th South and Wedgewood Houston areas. You're a short (safe) walk or cab ride away from some of the best food and shopping in the city.

The space
This is a single family condo that has recently been renovated. You will have access to the entire property, this is not a shared space.

Guest access
whole home

Other things to note
Park in front of the unit.
